Each carries her own struggles, yet together they support one another as they race to protect the wounded and vulnerable, often standing up against powerful forces. Through conflicts and hardships, the two gradually grow. No matter which way the wind blows, this unconventional duo continues their journey in search of happiness.

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: After passing the national exam, Kishimoto Satori (Yamada Anna), Kajita Ayaka (Toma Ami), and Kubo Zansetsu (Hagiwara Riku) begin careers caring for animals. When foot-and-mouth disease breaks out at a ranch, Satori works with Inukai Kentaro (Kamikawa Takaya) to contain the infection and faces the harsh realities of protecting animal lives.

E31
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E24
programme.desc: 改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: E1 - Morel Mushrooms
programme.desc: Each spring sees the start of the morel mushroom season in the Canadian West. Gaetan Dore has been participating in this rush for 'brown gold' for six years. In one day, the gatherer from the Montreal region can pick mushrooms to the value of 500 Canadian dollars.

programme.title: E22 - In Aix-Les-Bains, With Aurelie Saada
programme.desc: Mory Sacko is at the casino of Aix-les-Bains with singer Aurelie Saada. On today's menu: duckling with orange and genepi.

programme.title: E15 - Very Private Visits
programme.desc: A rare behind-the-scenes dive into hidden corners of Paris: the Paris-Vincennes racecourse, the Parc des Princes stadium, the Republican Guard headquarters... Usually inaccessible to the general public, these iconic sites open their doors to Paname.

programme.title: E11 - Granville, The Monaco Of The North
programme.desc: Aboard a Citroen convertible, Laurent visits Granville, one of Normandy's most popular seaside resorts. Famous for its carnival, he meets Yann to discover the secrets of the floats. Michel enjoys a ride in an amazing convertible.

programme.title: E10 - Agites Du Bocal: Lacto-Fermentation And Pickles
programme.desc: Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.

programme.title: E2 - My Island In Brittany
programme.desc: A new generation of men and women have chosen to live and work on the Ponant islands. We head to Ouessant, Sein and Saint-Riom to meet the people who have opted for this isolated existence on islands that are sometimes difficult to access, and are both challenging and enchanting.

programme.title: E14 - Behind The Scenes At The Liege Opera!
programme.desc: From the costume workshop to the sets and the accessory stockroom, a tour of the Liege Opera where 'Traviata' is performed. Also featuring director Jean-Marie Poire, landscape designer Alexandre Vandiest, Patrick Syen's Bentleys, and soprano Louise Foor.

programme.title: E3 - 新人入局 一見鐘情愛上他？
programme.desc: 以「尋找勢均力敵的參與者」為核心模式，通過團隊協作任務獲取生存物資，個人競技爭奪約會權，並設置淘汰機制與心動投票綁定規則；素人嘉賓們將逃離都市，直面愛情與生存的挑戰，在人群中尋找勢均力敵的彼此。

programme.title: E3 - 新人入局 一見鐘情愛上他？

programme.title: E4 - 向新疆第二站出發
programme.desc: 孟非、劉震雲決心效仿中國最早的自由行「西遊」，攜何廣智、李雅娟升級為「非震式旅行社」；邀請尹正、哈妮克孜、武藝、張雨綺、楊迪、楊超越等飛行嘉賓，先後到達喀什，塔什庫爾干，獨庫公路，烏茲別克斯坦等地，串聯起雪山草原、戈壁大漠、城市綠洲，開啟一場前所未有的奇遇之旅。

programme.title: E8 - 殘酷復活踢館賽開啟
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: E2 - 全員爭搶隱藏款
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 故事講述在1987年被囚禁的兩名男女之間奇怪而美麗的時間旅行，一個尋找過去連環殺人真相的男人和一個想要阻止爸爸媽媽結婚的女人相互意識到目標連接在一起的故事。​

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 對情感持絕對懷疑的「尹菲雅」，因心理創傷無法與人相處超過一小時。當她遇見感性卻陷入創作瓶頸的頂尖作家「韓善浩」，兩人因一款AI戀愛程式產生交集。她相信數據能篩選完美伴侶，他卻在虛擬對話中看見她傷痕下的真實。這段由演算法開始的相遇，，最終收穫愛情的故事。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 故事講述在1987年被囚禁的兩名男女之間奇怪而美麗的時間旅行，一個尋找過去連環殺人真相的男人和一個想要阻止爸爸媽媽結婚的女人相互意識到目標連接在一起的故事。​

programme.title: E14
programme.desc: 擁有雙重面貌卻守節十五年的蒙面寡婦，在白天是個足不出戶、行為謹慎的女人。到了晚上，她就會翻牆出去，戴著面紗去照顧那些有需要的人。在某天晚上卻遇到了追查年幼時慘死的父親死因的男人。這使她開始對未來有所憧憬。但當他們一起捲入一場意想不到的事件時，生活發生了巨大的變化。

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Wah is an unkempt, uneducated and undiplomatic guy who is doomed to be a loser of love. Bok Ping is a stylish Shanghai girl with a tycoon father. But Bok Ping decides to go to Hong Kong to seek her mother, who has departed from her when she was a child. She encounters Wah in the process and lives a simple life with Wah's mother. Wah, being influenced by Bok Ping, becomes more polite and cultured. Meanwhile, Bok Ping's father deems that Wah has kidnapped his daughter, but unexpectedly, Bok Ping has really been kidnapped...

programme.title: Best Actress- Jennifer Yu: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: A dead body and a hotchpotch of homeowners in a residential building on a single night: all hell breaks loose. As the Jewish axiom has it, “man thinks; God laughs.” On a night like any other, Ming, together with his wife and mother-in-law, finds an anonymous naked dead body lying at their doorstep. They might not know who the body was, but they have no doubt that their unit will become a “murder home” once this is exposed. Its property value will nosedive, and they will be transformed from blissful homeowners to miserable victims. So they decide to pass the buck to their neighbours. There are eleven living residents in four units on the same floor. Besides Ming's family of five, there are the retired elderly couple, Mr. & Mrs. Chan; the single lady Mary and her maid; and the Cheung's, an irascible father and his cantankerous son. Last but not least, there is this mysterious woman from an upper floor who chain smokes. This motley group of residents start fighting against one a

programme.title: The Plot
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. After finishing a flawlessly plotted case with no trace of evidence left behind, Young-il receives a new request. His new target is a prominent political figure who is always under the spotlight. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Lau Ching Wan: Overheard 3
programme.desc: Five Years ago, LAW was jailed for killing a major land owner in a car accident. At that time LAW worked as a chauffeur for the rural tycoon LUK. It was rumored that LUK was behind such land owner's death, which gave LUK a competitive edge in the native apartment development deal. Before the Hong Kong handover in 1997, every native, male resident in the New Territories was granted the right to build a house. Yet it had caused social unrest over the land right, until recently the government decided to gather all of the remaining land rights from these residents and plan to build taller apartment buildings. LUK wished to swallow the enormous project and this started the fights between LUK, the land owner and other real estate developers. When LAW gets out of prison five years later, the world has changed...

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie
programme.desc: Jung-hwan, a professional wild animal trainer, spends his days bickering and playing with his teenage daughter, Soo-ah, who is passionate about dancing. Then one day, Soo-ah gets infected by a zombie virus that sweeps across the world. To protect her, Jung-hwan takes Soo-ah to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Bam-soon, lives. In a society determined to root out the infected, Jung-hwan notices that Soo-ah still seems to understand words, responds to her favorite songs and dances, and even flinches when scolded by Grandma Bam-soon's back scratching stick. Refusing to give up on his daughter, Jung-hwan calls on his years of animal training experience and begins the top-secret mission of training his zombie daughter...

programme.title: LOVE RESET

Despite being brought together by a cinematic encounter that led to their storybook romance, the two have now grown sick of each other's nutty and loserish ways, finally deciding to become perfect strangers again.
